player_intent: A player can host a private 2v2 from either the itch browser build or a native build and share one room code with friends.
acceptance_rule: The restricted itch launcher exposes Host Private Match, connects only to the configured secure signaling service, installs a WebRTCMultiplayerPeer in res://multiplayer_slice.tscn, and keeps the host as authoritative peer 1 for the canonical lobby, shots, damage, and rounds. The signaling service admits at most four peers and relays only room, SDP, and ICE messages. Native builds retain the existing ENet listen-server path.

nodes.role: Lets browser and native players request the canonical private-host path.
Negotiates browser WebRTC peer connections through the lightweight signaling service without owning gameplay state.
Owns the installed multiplayer peer, authoritative lobby, player admission, shots, damage, rounds, and disconnect lifecycle.
Shows the copyable P2P room code after signaling creates a room.

must_not_change: SOCOM camera and reticle aim ownership
host-owned shot, damage, ammunition, and ballistics authority
weapon animation, fire recovery, reload, and hand-contact presentation
official Quick Match, server browser, and dedicated tournament code paths
visual_check: Deploy the signaling Blueprint, export the restricted Web build, open two independent browser sessions, host in the first, paste its P2P code into the second, and verify both enter the same canonical lobby before completing one authoritative shot-and-damage exchange. Strict NAT pairs require a configured TURN service even when STUN succeeds for ordinary networks.

system_delta.reason: Add WebRTC only as the browser transport and keep SocomMultiplayerSession as authoritative peer 1. This removes the full dedicated game server from private browser matches while preserving native ENet and official dedicated play.

current.system: Native ENet private host plus browser clients restricted to a full dedicated WebSocket game server

candidate.system: Browser WebRTC private host with a lightweight signaling-only service feeding the canonical multiplayer session
